context: Mrs. Mori and Sachiko celebrate fifty years of friendship.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 佐知子さん、五十年、ね、私たち。
lines.en: Sachiko — fifty years now, hasn't it.
lines.style: Soft, wondering opening. Pause on the dash. Warm nostalgia settling into the voice like a sigh. Not marveling — just witnessing the fact together. Gentle throughout.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.style: Quiet agreement, almost to herself. Philosophical acceptance in the pacing — not sad, just truthful. Breath carries warmth. Slight trailing-off, like she's settling into the feeling.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 思い出、数え切れない、ね。
lines.en: So many memories we couldn't even count them all.
lines.style: Rhythmic, gentle cataloging without listing. Slight lift on 'so many,' then softens back down. The warmth of abundance in her tone, not burden. Tender and marveling together.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.style: Direct and simple, the weight of fifty years compressed into these words. Deliberate pause before 'truly.' Voice steady, eyes probably getting a little wet. Deep sincerity, no performance.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: And from here on, together still.
lines.style: Soft promise, not grand. Gentle forward tilt in the voice — not anxious, but affirming. Warm hand-on-shoulder feeling. The steadiness of something chosen, again and again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お互い、健康で、続けたい。
lines.en: I want us both to stay healthy and keep going.
lines.style: Tender wish-making. Slow, careful pacing — each word carries intention. Voice dips slightly on 'healthy,' then rises gently on 'keep going.' Quiet hope, not demand.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.style: Closing statement, spoken like a small ceremony. Pause on the dash. Weight on 'every single day' — not rushed, each word its own moment. Voice warm and steady. This is what fifty years have taught her.
